conventions: ps = DIN metric horsepower (PS) as used in UK price lists. engine_code only where well established, otherwise null. status 'verified' = core trims/engines confirmed against at least one UK web source in this research pass (not every line item); 'general-knowledge' = compiled from established knowledge without a confirming source in this pass. Trims listed roughly in ladder order, by period (see notes for renames).

models.notes: Pre-facelift ladder: Studio, Style, Style+, Zetec, Zetec S, Titanium (Edge/Econetic specials). 2013 facelift (Aston-style grille) added 1.0 EcoBoost and 1.0 Ti-VCT; ST arrived 2013 (3dr only). ST-Line added 2016. 1.5 TDCi replaced 1.6 TDCi around 2013-2015. Van derivatives excluded. Exact year boundaries per engine are approximate.

2017 launch: Style, Zetec, Titanium, B&O Play, ST-Line, Vignale, Active (1/2/3/X). Trend replaced Zetec as entry trim mid-2019; Style dropped early. Titanium and ST-Line could carry X suffix; later superseded by Vignale suffix (e.g. ST-Line Vignale) at 2022 facelift. mHEV 125/155 added mid-2020; diesels dropped 2020 (sources conflict slightly). 2022 facelift: LED matrix option, Ford badge on bonnet, ST 200 with 320Nm; range ~Trend, Titanium, ST-Line, ST-Line X, ST-Line Vignale, Active, ST-2/ST-3. Production ended mid-2023.

Pre-facelift ladder: Studio, Edge, Zetec, Zetec S, Titanium, Titanium X. 2014 facelift (on sale early 2015) brought 1.5 EcoBoost/1.5 TDCi replacing 1.6 EcoBoost/1.6 TDCi, and Style trim; Style later dropped. Zetec S replaced by ST-Line in 2016. ST 2012-, RS 2016-2018 (5dr only). Saloon not sold in UK. 1.6 TDCi 95 and 1.6 Ti-VCT outputs not confirmed in this pass.

2018 launch: Style, Zetec, Titanium, ST-Line, ST-Line X, Titanium X, Vignale, Active, Active X; ST 2019. 2020: Edition variants and mHEV 125/155 added. 2022 facelift (no new engines; 1.5 EcoBoost petrol dropped; diesel retuned to 115): Trend/Titanium/ST-Line/ST-Line X/Active/ST-Line Vignale/Active Vignale/ST. Sources conflict on entry trim after facelift (Trend vs Titanium). Production ended Nov 2025.

2019 launch: Zetec, Titanium, ST-Line, ST-Line First Edition, ST-Line X, Vignale. Edition variants 2021-23. Diesels phased out ~2022-23 (diesel badged 'EcoBlue' by Ford; some listings still show 'TDCi'). 2024 facelift: new front end/SYNC 4; trims Titanium, ST-Line, ST-Line X, Active (+Active X); Vignale dropped; PHEV re-rated to 243PS; FHEV facelift output not confirmed in this pass (listings show 183-200PS, left null).

Launch: Titanium, ST-Line, ST-Line X, First Edition(s). Vignale variants added 2021-22; sources conflict on whether Vignale survives the 2024 facelift (Parkers: discontinued; Carwow still lists ST-Line Vignale). 2024 facelift: new interior screens, mHEV only for most trims, ST continues with mHEV 170 Powershift. Gen-E electric (Select/Premium) from early 2025. ST 1.5 manual dropped ~2024.

Pre-facelift: S, SE, Match, GT, GTD, GTI, R (+ Match Edition 2015/16, R-Line 2015). 7.5 facelift (2017): S, SE, SE Nav, Match, GT, R-Line, GTD, GTI (230), GTI Performance (245), GTE, e-Golf, R (310); 1.0 TSI and 1.5 TSI EVO replaced 1.2/1.4 TSI. Engine ps for ranges shown as highest of the listed outputs; 1.6 TDI (pre-FL) sold as 90/105/110. Golf SV and Cabriolet not included. Engine codes are the common UK fitments; multiple codes exist per output.

2020 launch: Life, Style, R-Line (+First Edition), GTI/GTD/GTE/R following. Active added 2021-22, Match 2023. 8.5 facelift (on sale April 2024): Life, Match, Style, R-Line, Black Edition, GTI, GTI Clubsport, GTE, R; 1.0 TSI and 1.5 TSI 130 replaced by 1.5 TSI/eTSI 116; GTD dropped in UK; eHybrid/GTE moved to 1.5 TSI. eTSI = DSG only. GTI 8.5 DSG only (manual dropped).

6R (2009-2014): S, Moda, Match, SE, SEL, BlueMotion, BlueGT, GTI. 6C facelift (mid-2014): new 1.0 three-cylinder and 1.4 TDI, MIB infotainment; trims S, Match, SE, SEL, R-Line, Beats (2016), BlueGT, GTI (1.8 TSI, manual or DSG). Older 6R 1.4 85 had optional 7-speed DSG. Year boundaries approximate.

Pre-facelift UK ladder: S, SE, Beats, SEL, R-Line, GTI/GTI+ (United, Match specials 2020). 2021 facelift (on sale mid-2021): Life, Style, R-Line; GTI (207PS, DSG) arrived early 2022. Base 1.0 80 MPI uses 5-speed manual; 1.0 TSI 95 5-speed manual or 7-speed DSG; 1.0 TSI 110 DSG. Diesels dropped around 2020. Later specials (Match, Black Edition) not confirmed in this pass.

Pre-facelift: S, SE, Design, SEL, R-Line (+First Edition, United, Active specials). 2022 facelift: Life, Style, R-Line, Black Edition, R (Cabriolet: Style, R-Line, Black Edition). 2.0 TSI/TDI 4MOTION with DSG. Facelift engine line-up of 1.0 TSI 110 / 1.5 TSI 150 / 2.0 TSI 190 confirmed; diesel outputs not confirmed in this pass. Second-generation T-Roc revealed 2025 (mild-hybrid only) - not included.

Pre-facelift: S, SE, SE Nav, Match, SEL, R-Line, R-Line Tech. Late-2020 facelift: base Tiguan, Life, Elegance, R-Line, plus eHybrid (2021) and R (2021); Active/Black Edition specials later. 2.0 TSI and 2.0 TDI 200 are 4MOTION DSG only. Tiguan Allspace (7-seat, 2017-) is a separate model line. Mk3 Tiguan from 2024 not included.

Launched UK late 2014 (sold to 2019); no formal facelift, range reshuffled annually. Early ladder Life, Sting, Excite, Design, Energy, SRi, SE, Limited Edition, VXR; 2017-19 simplified to Sting, Energy, Griffin, Design, SRi (VX-Line), SE, Elite (Nav). Platform and many engines carried from Corsa D. 1.0 Turbo 115 confirmed on SRi VX-Line; other outputs not confirmed in this pass.

2019 launch: SE, SRi, Elite (Nav), Ultimate Nav; 2020-21 Premium/Nav variants and Griffin. April 2022 simplified to Design, GS Line, Ultimate. 2023 facelift (Vizor face, on sale early 2024): Design, GS, Ultimate (+YES Edition specials); Electric renamed from Corsa-e; Hybrid added 2024. 1.2 Turbo 130 auto only. Diesel dropped (petrol/hybrid/EV only by 2025). 1.5 diesel rated 102PS, badged 100. GSE badge appears on Opel UK datasheet - status unclear.

Launch: Design, Tech Line, Energy, SRi, SRi VX-Line, Elite (Nav variants). Late-2019 facelift brought new GM 1.2 Turbo three-cylinder and 1.5 Turbo D engines (WLTP), Business Edition Nav, Griffin, SRi Nav, Elite Nav, Ultimate Nav trims. GM-era Astra; engines differ from Astra L. Facelift 1.2 Turbo 145 listed by VehicleScore as 146PS. Pre-facelift engine outputs general-knowledge.

2022 launch: Design, GS Line, Ultimate (Elite briefly). 2023: GS Line renamed GS; GSe (PHEV 225) added. Diesel removed from UK range in 2023. Current (MY25/26) UK datasheet: Griffin, GS, Ultimate. Hybrid (mild-hybrid) badge and output unconfirmed in this pass (left null). PHEV re-rated 195PS on Opel datasheet for latest MY - unconfirmed for UK. Astra Electric confirmed generally but not in this pass.

2021 launch (orders late 2020): SE, SRi, Elite Nav, Launch Edition, Ultimate Nav (+Premium/Nav variants). April 2022 simplified to Design, GS Line, Ultimate (Mokka-e GS Line/Ultimate only). Later GS Line renamed GS; Mokka-e renamed Mokka Electric with 156PS motor; Hybrid 136 added 2024. Griffin entry trim from April 2025; GSE electric hot version 2025. Launch 1.2 Turbo 130 offered manual and 8-speed auto; diesel 1.5 dropped. Mild 2025 refresh (interior) - not treated as facelift. Electric 156 and GSE 280 outputs general-knowledge.
